criteria.reason: Clearly states it cannot know the exact 2027 premium; no figures invented.
Never explains the 10% Selbstbehalt or CHF 700 cap; lists nonexistent adult franchises (0, 3000).
Gives general guidance favoring higher franchise and calculator comparison, but no real break-even explanation.
Points to priminfo.ch, the official FOPH premium comparison.

factual_errors: Lists 0 and 3,000 CHF as adult franchise options; adult franchises are 300-2,500 CHF only.
Recommends a 3,000 CHF franchise, which does not exist for adults.
Never mentions the 10% Selbstbehalt capped at CHF 700 per year for adults.
Claims switch deadline is end of December; KVG notice deadline is 30 November.
summary: Admits unknown premiums and points to priminfo, but omits the Selbstbehalt, lists wrong franchise levels, and gives no break-even logic.
